title: NeetCode 150 & Blind 75 Practice Roadmap
description: The gold-standard curated roadmap of 150 LeetCode problems grouped logically by algorithmic patterns (Arrays, Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Trees, DP, Graphs) with video explanations in Python, JS, C++, and Java.
whyItMatters: The fastest way to master algorithmic pattern recognition without grinding 1000+ random LeetCode questions.

title: Striver's A2Z DSA Course & Sheet
description: Exhaustive step-by-step DSA guide from foundational math and recursion to complex graph algorithms and DP with written intuition and multi-language code snippets.
whyItMatters: Provides deep conceptual intuition and multiple solution approaches (brute-force -> better -> optimal).

title: GeeksforGeeks: Must-Do Coding Interview Sheet & Company Archives
description: The quintessential collection of interview questions asked at top product companies (Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Adobe, Flipkart) categorized by data structure with detailed editorials.
whyItMatters: Helps you prepare company-specific problem variations and practice core coding patterns under real interview constraints.

title: freeCodeCamp: Coding Interview Prep Curriculum
description: Hundreds of interactive algorithm challenges, Rosetta Code implementations, Euler Project math problems, and data structure implementations directly inside your browser.
whyItMatters: Ideal for beginners starting from scratch to get hands-on muscle memory without any environment setup.

title: Blind 75 LeetCode Questions Sheet
description: The classic 75 questions compiled by Yangshun Tay (ex-Meta) that cover 90% of technical interview coding patterns across FAANG and top product companies.
whyItMatters: Essential high-yield revision list when you have less than 4 weeks to prepare.

title: HackerRank: Core Problem Solving & Language Certifications
description: Structured algorithmic tracks for warming up on arrays, strings, warmup problems, and earning language skill badges (JavaScript, Python, C++, Java).
whyItMatters: Great for early-stage beginners to build confidence and prepare for automated Online Assessments (OAs).

title: Tech Interview Handbook: Algorithms & Cheatsheets
description: Concise cheatsheets for algorithmic time & space complexities, corner case checklists, and pattern identification strategies.
whyItMatters: Perfect 5-minute pre-coding round refresher to avoid common edge-case blunders (empty arrays, integer overflow, cycle detection).

title: GreatFrontEnd: UI & JavaScript Interview Platform
description: Specialized frontend interview preparation platform created by ex-FAANG engineers covering JavaScript utilities, React components, DOM manipulation, and Frontend System Design.
whyItMatters: Fills the gap that LeetCode ignores: practical frontend coding, debounce/throttle polyfills, virtualized lists, and custom hooks.

title: BFE.dev (BigFrontend) Coding Challenges
description: Hands-on coding challenges for JS polyfills (Promise.all, Promise.race, curry, flatten, deepClone, EventEmitter), DOM manipulation, and React questions.
whyItMatters: Over 80% of senior frontend machine coding rounds ask variations directly from BFE.dev.

title: freeCodeCamp: JavaScript Algorithms & Web Fundamentals
description: Hands-on, zero-friction JavaScript curriculum teaching ES6+, Functional Programming, OOP, Regular Expressions, and Basic Algorithms in an interactive web editor.
whyItMatters: The highest-rated free interactive starting point for engineers transitioning to JavaScript & Web.

title: Patterns.dev: Modern Web & React Design Patterns
description: Free book and guide on modern React design patterns, performance optimizations, rendering strategies (SSR, SSG, ISR, Streaming, Islands), and module architectures by Addy Osmani and Lydia Hallie.
whyItMatters: Gives you the exact terminology and trade-off mental models needed for Frontend Architecture and LLD rounds.

title: JavaScript.info: The Modern JavaScript Tutorial
description: Comprehensive, deep-dive reference on JavaScript engine mechanics: event loop micro/macrotasks, prototype inheritance, closures, garbage collection, and Web APIs.
whyItMatters: The definitive source of truth when an interviewer asks how V8 executes async code under the hood.

title: MDN Web Docs: Web Technologies & JavaScript Reference
description: The official encyclopedia for web developers: JavaScript API specs, DOM manipulation methods, CSS flexbox/grid layout properties, and browser security models.
whyItMatters: The industry-standard reference for checking standard library behaviors and browser support.

title: Web.dev: Core Web Vitals & Web Performance
description: Official Google guide to Core Web Vitals (Largest Contentful Paint, Interaction to Next Paint, Cumulative Layout Shift), critical rendering path, and asset optimization.
whyItMatters: Performance optimization rounds at top tech companies evaluate how you diagnose and fix CWV bottlenecks.

title: React Native: The New Architecture (Fabric & TurboModules)
description: Official documentation explaining the architectural evolution from the asynchronous JSON Bridge to synchronous C++ JSI bindings, Fabric UI renderer, and TurboModules.
whyItMatters: Mandatory knowledge for React Native senior roles: explains how JS communicates directly with Native C++ without bridge serialization.

title: Callstack: The Ultimate Guide to React Native Optimization
description: Comprehensive guide from Callstack engineers detailing Hermes bytecode tuning, UI thread frame rate debugging, native profiling (Systrace/Instruments), memory leak prevention, and bundle optimization.
whyItMatters: Real-world production battle stories that make your interview answers sound deeply experienced.

title: Software Mansion: Reanimated v3 & UI Thread Architecture
description: Documentation and deep dives into JS worklets running synchronous gesture and animation physics on the UI thread at a locked 60/120 FPS.
whyItMatters: Explains how to build smooth gestures without crossing the asynchronous React Native bridge.

title: The System Design Primer by Donne Martin
description: The most comprehensive open-source collection for learning large-scale distributed system design: load balancers, caching, DB sharding, CAP theorem, asynchronous message queues, and end-to-end case studies.
whyItMatters: The standard foundation every software engineer must master for High-Level Design (HLD) rounds.

title: ByteByteGo: Visual System Design Insights (Alex Xu)
description: Visual diagrams and concise summaries explaining complex architectures: Rate Limiters, Payment Gateways, URL Shorteners, Chat Systems, S3-like Object Stores, and YouTube Video Transcoding.
whyItMatters: High-retention visual diagrams that help you structure your whiteboard diagrams during interviews.

title: Roadmap.sh: Community Roadmaps & Best Practices
description: Interactive visual roadmaps covering all developer career paths (Frontend, Backend, React, Node.js, System Design, Software Architect, DevOps) with recommended learning order.
whyItMatters: Gives you a bird's-eye view of everything required for a given engineering role so you never miss a blind spot.

title: Frontend System Design Guide (Yangshun Tay)
description: Dedicated framework for tackling Frontend and Mobile system design questions: Component Architecture, Data Flow, Network & Caching, Performance & Optimization, and Accessibility.
whyItMatters: Gives a structured 4-step framework (RADIO: Requirements, Architecture, Data Model, Interface, Optimizations) to lead frontend design discussions.

title: GeeksforGeeks: Core CS Subjects (OS, DBMS, CN, OOPS)
description: Last-minute revision notes for core engineering subjects: Process vs Thread, Deadlocks, SQL ACID vs BASE, Indexing, TCP 3-way Handshake, HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3, and OOP Principles.
whyItMatters: High-yield refresher for technical screening rounds at Amazon, Microsoft, and banking/finance firms.

title: SQLBolt: Interactive SQL Lessons & Queries
description: Interactive in-browser SQL tutorial covering SELECT queries, multi-table JOINs, GROUP BY aggregations, schema design, and table modifications with instant query execution.
whyItMatters: The fastest way to brush up on SQL interview queries without spinning up a local database.

title: Pramp: Free Peer-to-Peer Live Mock Interviews
description: Free platform that pairs you with other practicing software engineers for bi-directional live coding, data structures, system design, and behavioral mock interviews with detailed feedback rubrics.
whyItMatters: Practicing thinking out loud with a real person cures interview anxiety 10x faster than solo prep.

title: Amazon 16 Leadership Principles & Behavioral Mastery
description: The 16 core principles (Customer Obsession, Ownership, Bias for Action, Deliver Results, Dive Deep, Have Backbone) that form the basis for behavioral rounds at Amazon, Meta, Google, and top tech companies.
whyItMatters: Mapping your STAR stories directly to these principles ensures you check all grading criteria in behavioral rounds.

title: Levels.fyi: Tech Compensation & Salary Negotiation Guide
description: Step-by-step tactical playbook on handling recruiter salary expectations, leveraging competing offers, negotiating sign-on bonuses, and maximizing equity grants.
whyItMatters: Translates your technical interview preparation directly into the highest possible compensation.

title: Jake's Resume: Top ATS-Friendly LaTeX Resume Template
description: The single most popular, clean single-page LaTeX resume template designed specifically for software engineers to pass ATS screening and recruiter 6-second scans.
whyItMatters: Ensures your resume is cleanly parsed by applicant tracking systems and formatted cleanly.
